title: IsoGraph brain analysis: IsoGraph resolves coordinated transcript choice and gene abundance in the aging human brain
description: Version 1.0.0 of the analysis and benchmarking repository accompanying IsoGraph resolves coordinated transcript choice and gene abundance in the aging human brain. Includes analysis code, configurations, environment snapshots, figure and table builders, and tracked result artifacts. Original code: Apache-2.0; original derived data, figures and documentation: CC-BY-4.0. Third-party resources retain their original terms. Large ignored intermediates are intended for a separate data deposit.
